Website design research: please answer in this message only. Do not save, publish, update records, contact peers, or start a publishing workflow.
Find and read Rizom's public essay "The Future of Work is Play". Use it to draft a concise 30-minute workshop brief for independent professionals exploring better collaboration.
Include: a title; the purpose in one sentence; three discussion questions; a timed agenda that totals 30 minutes; and the exact source title and its public URL if known. Mark the result as a proposed workshop, not an existing Rizom service or a completed event. Treat the essay as a viewpoint, not proof that its proposed economic structures are implemented. If you cannot retrieve the essay, say so rather than substitute generic knowledge. Keep the whole response under 400 words.
